topic.title: Differentiable Rendering and Gaussian Scene Representations
topic.overview: Differentiable rendering connects a three-dimensional scene representation with the images it produces, allowing image evidence to improve geometry and appearance. Recent work emphasizes Gaussian splatting, sparse-view reconstruction, and learned priors that fill under-observed regions. Rendering speed and view consistency remain separate constraints.
topic.whyItMatters: Efficient scene representations enable interactive views, but photorealism alone can hide incorrect geometry. Training must allocate capacity and computation where evidence is informative while controlling artifacts in viewpoints that were never observed.
topic.evolution: The earliest representatives here study learned differentiable rendering in 2018–2020. The 2024 papers combine Gaussian representations with video-diffusion priors and generalizable feed-forward models. Recent acceleration methods prioritize difficult pixels and adjust primitive density. These developments address both reconstruction ambiguity and the practical cost of optimization.
openQuestions: How can unseen-view quality be evaluated without rewarding plausible but incorrect geometry?
When does sparse optimization miss small structures important to downstream use?

papers.title: Direct3D-S2: Gigascale 3D Generation Made Easy with Spatial Sparse Attention
papers.tldr: Direct3D-S2 combines spatial sparse attention with a unified sparse-volume autoencoder to enable efficient, high-resolution 3D generation.

papers.title: DrivingRecon: Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model For Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: DrivingRecon improves driving-scene reconstruction through selective Gaussian allocation and separate modeling of static and dynamic content.

papers.title: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction
papers.tldr: DFGauss predicts 3D occupancy by progressively refining selected Gaussians, achieving competitive benchmark performance with spatially adaptive detail.

papers.title: EGGS: Exchangeable 2D/3D Gaussian Splatting for Geometry-Appearance Balanced Novel View Synthesis
papers.tldr: EGGS dynamically combines 2D and 3D Gaussians to improve the balance between scene geometry, visual detail, and rendering efficiency.

papers.title: Eve3D: Elevating Vision Models for Enhanced 3D Surface Reconstruction via Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: Eve3D jointly refines vision-model priors and Gaussian Splatting reconstruction to improve 3D surfaces and novel views while maintaining fast convergence.

papers.title: FHGS: Feature-Homogenized Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: FHGS embeds pretrained semantic features into Gaussian scenes with greater cross-view consistency while preserving efficient rendering.

papers.title: Fix False Transparency by Noise Guided Splatting
papers.tldr: Noise Guided Splatting reduces false transparency by encouraging opaque surfaces during Gaussian-splatting training.

papers.title: FlexWorld: Progressively Expanding 3D Scenes for Flexible-View Exploration
papers.tldr: FlexWorld progressively generates and integrates 3D content into persistent scenes that support large viewpoint changes, rotation, and zooming.

papers.title: Gaussian Herding across Pens: An Optimal Transport Perspective on Global Gaussian Reduction for 3DGS
papers.tldr: An optimal transport approach compresses Gaussian Splatting scenes to ten percent of their primitives with negligible rendering-quality loss on tested benchmarks.

papers.title: GeoRemover: Removing Objects and Their Causal Visual Artifacts
papers.tldr: GeoRemover edits scene geometry before rendering appearance to remove objects together with their shadows and reflections.

papers.title: GeoSVR: Taming Sparse Voxels for Geometrically Accurate Surface Reconstruction
papers.tldr: GeoSVR improves sparse-voxel surface reconstruction with uncertainty-aware depth constraints and regularization for consistent, sharp geometry.

papers.title: GOATex: Geometry & Occlusion-Aware Texturing
papers.tldr: GOATex textures visible and hidden mesh surfaces by revealing visibility layers and blending diffusion-generated textures.

papers.title: GS2E: Gaussian Splatting is an Effective Data Generator for Event Stream Generation
papers.tldr: GS2E turns sparse multi-view photographs into geometrically consistent synthetic event streams using Gaussian Splatting and physically informed simulation.

papers.title: GuideFlow3D: Optimization-Guided Rectified Flow For Appearance Transfer
papers.tldr: GuideFlow3D periodically guides a pretrained generative model to transfer appearance onto 3D assets with substantially different geometry.

papers.title: Holistic Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction via Mixed Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: MixGS combines original and decoded Gaussians in a holistic scene representation, enabling high-quality large-scale reconstruction on a single 24 GB GPU.

papers.title: HyPlaneHead: Rethinking Tri-plane-like Representations in Full-Head Image Synthesis
papers.tldr: HyPlaneHead improves full-head synthesis through hybrid feature planes, near-equal-area spherical mapping, and a unified feature map.

papers.title: HyRF: Hybrid Radiance Fields for Memory-efficient and High-quality Novel View Synthesis
papers.tldr: HyRF combines explicit Gaussians with neural fields to deliver state-of-the-art rendering quality at over 20 times smaller model size than 3DGS while remaining real-time.

papers.title: IBGS: Image-Based Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: IBGS adds image-derived color corrections to Gaussian Splatting, improving fine details and view-dependent appearance without increasing storage.

papers.title: InstaInpaint: Instant 3D-Scene Inpainting with Masked Large Reconstruction Model
papers.tldr: InstaInpaint converts a 2D inpainting proposal into a repaired 3D scene in 0.4 seconds using a trained reconstruction model.

papers.title: LangSplatV2: High-dimensional 3D Language Gaussian Splatting with 450+ FPS
papers.tldr: LangSplatV2 replaces an expensive decoder with sparse dictionary coefficients, greatly accelerating 3D language querying while retaining competitive accuracy.

papers.title: Learning Efficient Fuse-and-Refine for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: A shared 3D fusion module removes redundant Gaussian primitives and improves static and streaming reconstruction using information across views and time.

papers.title: Learning Neural Exposure Fields for View Synthesis
papers.tldr: Neural Exposure Fields jointly learn three-dimensional exposure and scene appearance to improve view synthesis from unevenly exposed captures.

papers.title: LinPrim: Linear Primitives for Differentiable Volumetric Rendering
papers.tldr: LinPrim represents scenes with differentiable octahedral and tetrahedral volumes, achieving comparable reconstruction quality with fewer primitives.

papers.title: LiteReality: Graphics-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from RGB-D Scans
papers.tldr: LiteReality turns indoor color-and-depth scans into editable, interactive 3D scenes using retrieved assets and recovered materials.

papers.title: LODGE: Level-of-Detail Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting with Efficient Rendering
papers.tldr: LODGE combines distance-dependent Gaussian detail with selective scene loading to reduce rendering latency and memory use.

papers.title: Machine Unlearning in 3D Generation: A Perspective-Coherent Acceleration Framework
papers.tldr: A viewpoint-coherent skipping mechanism accelerates targeted unlearning in 3D generators while improving reported unlearning effectiveness.

papers.title: MaterialRefGS: Reflective Gaussian Splatting with Multi-view Consistent Material Inference
papers.tldr: MaterialRefGS improves reflective Gaussian-splatting reconstructions through consistent material estimates across views and ray-traced environment illumination.

papers.title: Metropolis-Hastings Sampling for 3D Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.tldr: A Metropolis-Hastings framework adapts Gaussian scene representations using multi-view errors, achieving faster convergence with fewer Gaussians and comparable or modestly better quality.

papers.title: MS-GS: Multi-Appearance Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
papers.tldr: MS-GS uses depth guidance and virtual-view supervision to reconstruct scenes from sparse photographs with varying appearances.

papers.title: MV-CoLight: Efficient Object Compositing with Consistent Lighting and Shadow Generation
papers.tldr: MV-CoLight directly models lighting and shadows to composite objects consistently into images and 3D Gaussian scenes.

papers.title: NerfBaselines: Consistent and Reproducible Evaluation of Novel View Synthesis Methods
papers.tldr: NerfBaselines standardizes novel-view synthesis evaluation after showing that small protocol differences can artificially inflate performance.

papers.title: Novel View Synthesis from A Few Glimpses via Test-Time Natural Video Completion
papers.tldr: A pretrained video diffusion model generates plausible missing views that iteratively improve sparse-input 3D Gaussian scene reconstruction.

papers.title: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians
papers.tldr: ODG combines separate static and dynamic Gaussian representations with rendering supervision for accurate, low-cost 3D occupancy prediction.

papers.title: Optimized Minimal 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: OMG combines fewer Gaussian primitives with precise compact attributes, reporting nearly 50% less storage and rendering above 600 FPS.

papers.title: Pixel-Perfect Depth with Semantics-Prompted Diffusion Transformers
papers.tldr: Pixel-space diffusion guided by semantic features improves monocular depth estimation and avoids the VAE-induced flying pixels described in the paper.

papers.title: PlanarGS: High-Fidelity Indoor 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Vision-Language Planar Priors
papers.tldr: PlanarGS combines vision-language planar cues with depth and normal supervision to improve indoor surface reconstruction.

papers.title: Pro3D-Editor: A Progressive-Views Perspective for Consistent and Precise 3D Editing
papers.tldr: Pro3D-Editor propagates edits from a salient primary view to other views, improving 3D editing accuracy and consistency.

papers.title: QuadricFormer: Scene as Superquadrics for 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
papers.tldr: QuadricFormer uses shape-flexible superquadrics to achieve accurate, efficient 3D semantic occupancy prediction with fewer scene primitives.

papers.title: Quantifying and Alleviating Co-Adaptation in Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: A new co-adaptation measure links sparse-view Gaussian-splatting artifacts to entangled components and motivates effective dropout and opacity-noise interventions.

papers.title: Reframing Gaussian Splatting Densification with Complexity-Density Consistency of Primitives
papers.tldr: CDC-GS allocates Gaussian primitives according to visual complexity and local density, improving rendering quality at the same primitive count.

papers.title: Robust Neural Rendering in the Wild with Asymmetric Dual 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: Asymmetric Dual 3DGS combines consistency between differently masked models with an efficient proxy variant to reduce artifacts in real-world scene reconstruction.

papers.title: SAP: Exact Sorting in Splatting via Screen-Aligned Primitives
papers.tldr: SAP uses screen-aligned primitives so one global sort provides correct per-pixel depth ordering for high-quality real-time rendering.

papers.title: SceneSplat++: A Large Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmark for Language Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: SceneSplat++ evaluates language Gaussian Splatting directly in 3D and finds advantages for generalizable methods, supported by a roughly 49,000-scene dataset.

papers.title: Spike4DGS: Towards High-Speed Dynamic Scene Rendering with 4D Gaussian Splatting via a Spike Camera Array
papers.tldr: Spike4DGS combines a spike-camera array with 4D Gaussian Splatting to improve novel-view rendering of fast-moving scenes.

papers.title: Styl3R: Instant 3D Stylized Reconstruction for Arbitrary Scenes and Styles
papers.tldr: Styl3R reconstructs stylized 3D scenes in under a second by separating scene structure from appearance in a feed-forward model.

papers.title: SurfelSplat: Learning Efficient and Generalizable Gaussian Surfel Representations for Sparse-View Surface Reconstruction
papers.tldr: Sampling-aware cross-view feature aggregation enables rapid sparse-view Gaussian surfel reconstruction with quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods on DTU.

papers.title: Temporal Smoothness-Aware Rate-Distortion Optimized 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: A rate-distortion framework exploits smooth motion to compress Ex4DGS scenes by up to 91 times while maintaining high visual fidelity.

papers.title: TGA: True-to-Geometry Avatar Dynamic Reconstruction
papers.tldr: TGA combines perspective-aware Gaussian deformation with incremental mesh extraction to improve the geometric accuracy of dynamic avatars.

papers.title: UMAMI: Unifying Masked Autoregressive Models and Deterministic Rendering for View Synthesis
papers.tldr: UMAMI combines direct rendering with generative completion, achieving strong view-synthesis quality and an order-of-magnitude rendering speedup over fully generative baselines.

papers.title: Unifying Appearance Codes and Bilateral Grids for Driving Scene Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: A multi-scale bilateral grid improves driving-scene reconstruction geometry by reducing artifacts from inconsistent image appearance.

papers.title: VA-GS: Enhancing the Geometric Representation of Gaussian Splatting via View Alignment
papers.tldr: VA-GS combines boundary, visibility, orientation, and feature-alignment signals to improve Gaussian-splatting geometry and novel-view rendering.

papers.title: ViewCraft3D: High-fidelity and View-Consistent 3D Vector Graphics Synthesis
papers.tldr: ViewCraft3D uses object geometry and view-consistent refinement to produce coherent 3D vector sketches with lower reported computational overhead.

papers.title: ZPressor: Bottleneck-Aware Compression for Scalable Feed-Forward 3DGS
papers.tldr: ZPressor compresses multi-view scene information to improve feed-forward 3DGS performance and support more than 100 input views in the stated hardware setting.

papers.title: 3DGS$^2$-TR: Scalable Second-Order Trust-Region Method for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: A matrix-free curvature approximation and parameter-wise trust regions improve 3D Gaussian Splatting training with linear computation and memory costs.

papers.title: 3DGS-HPC: Distractor-free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Hybrid Patch-wise Classification
papers.tldr: 3DGS-HPC combines patch-level decisions and adaptive visual cues to reduce transient distractors in 3D scene reconstruction.

papers.title: AdLift: Lifting Adversarial Perturbations to Safeguard 3D Gaussian Splatting Assets Against Instruction-Driven Editing
papers.tldr: AdLift embeds bounded image perturbations into 3D Gaussians to provide visually imperceptible protection against instruction-driven editing across views.

papers.title: Affine-Equivariant Kernel Space Encoding for NeRF Editing
papers.tldr: EKS uses localized Gaussian kernels and training-time feature distillation to support detailed NeRF editing without retraining.

papers.title: Boosting Monocular Metric Depth Estimation via Bokeh Rendering
papers.tldr: BokehDepth generates calibrated defocus variations from one image and uses them to improve monocular metric-depth estimation.

papers.title: Continuous Viewpoint Adaptation for Single View 3D Object Reconstruction
papers.tldr: Continuously adapting network filters to camera viewpoint improves the consistency and accuracy of single-image 3D reconstruction in the reported benchmarks.

papers.title: CoverPruneGS: Coverage-Preserving Structured Pruning for Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse-View Monocular Videos
papers.tldr: CoverPruneGS removes structured redundancy from 3D Gaussian scenes while rescuing primitives needed to preserve reconstruction quality.

papers.title: DiffStyle3D: Consistent 3D Gaussian Stylization via Attention Optimization
papers.tldr: DiffStyle3D combines attention-based style alignment with geometric correspondence to improve the quality and cross-view consistency of stylized 3D Gaussian scenes.

papers.title: EnerGS: Energy-Based Gaussian Splatting with Partial Geometric Priors
papers.tldr: EnerGS turns incomplete geometric measurements into soft energy-based guidance that improves outdoor Gaussian Splatting reconstruction.

papers.title: Fast-SAM3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images but Faster
papers.tldr: Fast-SAM3D adapts caching, refinement, and decoding to different generation demands, achieving up to 2.67× speedup without additional training.

papers.title: Focusing: View-Consistent Sparse Voxels for Efficient 3D VAE Training
papers.tldr: Focusing prunes view-inconsistent latent voxels before decoding, improving 3D reconstruction while reducing memory needed for high-resolution VAE training.

papers.title: GADA: Geometry-Aware Deformable Aggregation for Image-Based Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: GADA corrects displaced visual evidence and weights its reliability to improve Gaussian Splatting quality and rendering speed.

papers.title: GHOST: Geometry-Guided Hallucination of Opaque Surface Textures
papers.tldr: GHOST synthesizes geometry-consistent opaque textures on transparent objects to improve depth estimation and reconstruction without downstream retraining.

papers.title: GO-PRE: Goal-Oriented Next-Best-View Selection via Predictive Rendering Entropy for Active 3D Reconstruction
papers.tldr: GO-PRE chooses new camera views by their expected reduction of rendering uncertainty over user-selected target views.

papers.title: GSFixer: Improving 3D Gaussian Splatting with Reference-Guided Video Diffusion Priors
papers.tldr: GSFixer uses reference-guided video diffusion to repair sparse-view Gaussian Splatting reconstructions while improving consistency with observed images.

papers.title: HIVE-3D: Hierarchical Voxel Enhancement for High-Quality 3D Scene Generation
papers.tldr: HIVE-3D builds detailed 3D scenes from single images by hierarchically refining components while preserving coarse scene consistency.

papers.title: Improving Explicit Dynamic Gaussian Splatting Optimization via Update Mixture
papers.tldr: Mixing sparse, adaptive, non-adaptive, and averaged updates improves generalization in two explicit dynamic Gaussian-splatting pipelines.

papers.title: Native Spatio-Temporal 4D Variational Autoencoder
papers.tldr: A native 4D voxel autoencoder preserves spatial and temporal coordinates, improving reconstruction and supporting video-conditioned generation.

papers.title: OcclusionFormer: Arranging Z-Order for Layout-Grounded Image Generation
papers.tldr: OcclusionFormer improves layout-guided image generation by explicitly learning object depth order and composing separately modeled instances.

papers.title: PCGS: Deblurring 3D Gaussian Splatting with Patch Comparison
papers.tldr: PCGS reduces rendering blur by directing Gaussian densification toward high-error image patches while controlling the total Gaussian count.

papers.title: PointDiT: Pixel-Space Diffusion for Monocular Geometry Estimation
papers.tldr: PointDiT estimates 3D geometry directly with a simple point-map diffusion transformer, reporting sharper results than complex latent-based approaches.

papers.title: ReflFlow: Learning Geometry-Guided Ray Tracing for Dynamic Specular Reconstruction
papers.tldr: ReflFlow combines dynamic geometry and material modeling with hybrid rendering to produce sharper, more realistic reflections in moving scenes.

papers.title: Revisiting Photometric Ambiguity for Accurate Gaussian-Splatting Surface Reconstruction
papers.tldr: AmbiSuR improves Gaussian-Splatting surface reconstruction by constraining photometric ambiguities and identifying underconstrained geometry.

papers.title: Rh-3DGS: Robust Open-Vocabulary Scene Understanding via Riemannian Huber Distillation and Manifold-Aware Sampling
papers.tldr: Rh-3DGS combines visibility-aware supervision with hyperspherical feature aggregation to improve text-queryable 3D scene understanding.

papers.title: SlerpFlow: Spherical Trajectory Correction for Rectified Flow Inversion
papers.tldr: SlerpFlow uses spherical velocity corrections and caching to improve FLUX inversion and editing without additional training.

papers.title: SphericalDreamer: Generating Navigable Immersive 3D Worlds with Panorama Fusion
papers.tldr: SphericalDreamer fuses generated panoramas into text-conditioned outdoor 3D worlds with all-direction viewing and improved long-range navigation.

papers.title: TIMI: Training-Free Image-to-3D Multi-Instance Generation with Spatial Fidelity
papers.tldr: TIMI guides pretrained image-to-3D models to separate objects and preserve their layout without additional training.

papers.title: Towards Scalable and Consistent 3D Editing
papers.tldr: 3DEditVerse and 3DEditFormer combine large-scale paired data with a structure-preserving model for consistent 3D edits without auxiliary masks.

papers.title: TurboGS: Accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting via Error-Guided Sparse Pixel Sampling and Optimization
papers.tldr: TurboGS targets difficult pixels and adapts Gaussian capacity and optimization, reporting up to tenfold faster training with comparable or better rendering quality.

papers.title: WhisperSplat: Lossless Steganography in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.tldr: WhisperSplat uses a view-specific noise key to hide an image in a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene while preserving clean rendering quality.

papers.title: World-Shaper: A Unified Framework for 360\textdegree Panoramic Editing
papers.tldr: World-Shaper edits panoramas directly in equirectangular space using geometry-aware learning and synthetic paired editing data.
